section.10: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah)

10.name_native: The Book of Leading the Prayer (Al-Imamah)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to enjoin upon us to make the prayer short, but he would lead us in prayer and recite As-Saffat
